text_block_list.text:
Today is a joint dance lesson.
I came to take a peek at how things are going.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Resonate, fanfare♪
Reach all the way to the goal line~♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Fwahooo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Because I want to see~ a shining future with you~♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Fluffy-wuffy King-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Digital-san.
You won't improve your dancing just by doing call-and-response chants, you know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah...?! S-Sorry!
Habit just got the better of me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Geez, well then, Digital-san is up next. I'll switch over to reviewing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? N-No way... My dancing would just be an eyesore to someone like King...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Then that makes a check all the more necessary.
After all, I refuse to let someone who trained with the King step onto a half-baked stage."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hau! Miss King is being so considerate...!
O-Oh gosh...! I-I can't breathe!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I will master the dance
and make the stage... the Winning Live—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I will make it a success, even if it costs me my life!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho!
Let's see that resolve of yours!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
Trainer, what kind of dance should I use to express my determination!?
choice_data_list: Let's try tackling a high-difficulty dance.
Time to bring out my best dance—let's go!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright! I'll give it a try!
Music... start!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Tra-la-la~ Tra-la-la-la~... Wh-Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Kh... If I'm struggling at this level,
how can I ever convey my resolve to King-san...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No whining!
Come on, let's crush your weaknesses first!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haoh...?! M-Miss King...!
N-No, Digitan...! You can't... grin yet... Nooo...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
B-But, but, but, King-san's kindness is...
just... 2000% blessed... Hehehe♪
"Agnes Digital pushed through the joint lesson while fiercely battling her own desires!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I-In that case, please do the same choreography that King-san did earlier...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Resonate, fanfare~♪
Reach all the wa~y to the goal line~♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...!? Y-You're
actually pretty good...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? R-R-Really!?
Getting praised by King-san... I can't believe it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
N-Now, let's resume the lesson.
...I am NOT going to lose.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh... King is in serious mode!
●REC... No wait, gotta focus
and be professional...!

They're having a great influence on each other.
It turned out to be a very meaningful joint lesson!
